fieldRoles.name: abilityScores
fieldRoles.description: Which object field is this System's ability/stat block. Optional `targetPath` (a dotted write path) says where resolved scores are written on a Character; absent means top-level.

fieldRoles.name: combatBindings
fieldRoles.description: Which array field carries this System's live play-state bindings (HP/AC/Initiative/...) — each value tagged with a combatBindings binding (resource/value/tags/modifier).

fieldRoles.name: combatScaling
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's Combat Scaling / Challenge Rating table (Crucible).

fieldRoles.name: creatureType
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's Creature Type vocabulary (Crucible, Loom).

fieldRoles.name: archetypeTable
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's NPC Archetype roll table (Forge).

fieldRoles.name: npcAttitude
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's NPC Attitude level table (Forge).

fieldRoles.name: generatorProperty
fieldRoles.description: An array field whose values carry a `cost` — one of Vault's generator-property tables (Rarity, Activation, ...). A System declares one entry per property-bearing field.

fieldRoles.name: budgetCeiling
fieldRoles.description: Which one generatorProperty field's chosen value sets Vault's overall budget ceiling.

fieldRoles.name: environment
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's Environment/biome vocabulary (Sanctum).

fieldRoles.name: savingThrows
fieldRoles.description: Which array field is this System's saving-throws display list (Workbench's Build Wizard).

combatBindings.name: resource
combatBindings.description: A value with a current amount and (optionally) a max/temp — renders as number inputs for each, read/write via recordField/maxPath/tempPath. E.g. Hit Points, Daggerheart's Hope/Stress.

combatBindings.name: value
combatBindings.description: A single flat number — renders as one number input, read/write via recordField. E.g. Armor Class.

combatBindings.name: tags
combatBindings.description: A list of string tags — renders as a tag-badge/tag-input widget, read/write via recordField (as an array); optional sourceField names which other field supplies the tag vocabulary. E.g. Conditions.

combatBindings.name: modifier
combatBindings.description: A read-only number feeding a Roll button — read via recordField, never written. E.g. Initiative.

derivedFormulas.name: abilityModifier
derivedFormulas.description: Given an ability score, the modifier applied to rolls using it.

derivedFormulas.name: hitPointsPerLevelAverage
derivedFormulas.description: Average HP gained per level from a hit-die-shaped resource, used for level-up growth.

derivedFormulas.name: proficiencyBonusForLevel
derivedFormulas.description: The proficiency bonus for a given total character level.

derivedFormulas.name: diceAverage
derivedFormulas.description: The average result of a parsed dice expression.

derivedFormulas.name: attackBonus
derivedFormulas.description: An attack roll's total bonus from ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

derivedFormulas.name: saveDC
derivedFormulas.description: A save DC derived from ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

derivedFormulas.name: averageDamage
derivedFormulas.description: The average damage of a parsed dice expression plus an ability modifier.

derivedFormulas.name: moveRate
derivedFormulas.description: A derived movement rate from an ability score (e.g. Call of Cthulhu's Move).

derivedFormulas.name: hitPoints
derivedFormulas.description: A resource-pool's own max-value formula, read generically alongside magicPoints/sanityStart for any System with a matching resource.

derivedFormulas.name: magicPoints
derivedFormulas.description: Call of Cthulhu's Magic Points pool max-value formula.

derivedFormulas.name: sanityStart
derivedFormulas.description: Call of Cthulhu's starting Sanity formula.

levelUpBindings.name: resourceGrowth
levelUpBindings.description: Per-level growth of a hit-die-shaped resource, sourced from the named Library kind's own record.

levelUpBindings.name: featureLevels
levelUpBindings.description: Which levels grant new class/subclass features, per the named Library kind.

levelUpBindings.name: equipmentChoices
levelUpBindings.description: Starting-equipment choice options declared on the named Library kind's own record.

levelUpBindings.name: proficiencyChoices
levelUpBindings.description: Proficiency choice options declared on the named Library kind's own record.

levelUpBindings.name: proficiencyGrants
levelUpBindings.description: Fixed (non-chosen) proficiency grants declared on the named Library kind's own record.

levelUpBindings.name: savingThrowGrants
levelUpBindings.description: Which saving throws a class/kind grants proficiency in.

levelUpBindings.name: classProgressionTable
levelUpBindings.description: A per-level table of named columns (BAB, Fort/Ref/Will, ...) declared on the named Library kind's own record.

keys.description: The single explicit, Loom-authored mapping of "which field plays this role" — see bindings.fieldRoles above for the closed set. Each value is {sourceField, binding, ...role-specific extras} — sourceField names a sibling field on this System (dot-nestable), the same concept combatBindings' own tags binding sourceField already uses.

Workbench's Build Character wizard — the entire step sequence for this System, in array order. Each value is {step, name, ...step-specific data} — name is the step's own display text, the same Name every other reserved-key value uses to identify itself, not a separate label. A System with more than one creatable Template sharing it (Blades in the Dark: Character AND Crew) may instead declare this as type "object", keyed by Template id, each value an ordinary buildSteps array.

Role-dispatch bindings the level-up engine reads generically — see bindings.levelUpBindings above for the closed set, each scoped per `libraryKind` (a binding may exist once for "class" and once for "background"). Each value is {binding, libraryKind, libraryField, ...}.

Named `=formula` expressions (ability modifiers, proficiency bonus, damage averages, ...) evaluated generically via derived-formulas.js — see bindings.derivedFormulas above for the closed set. Each value is {binding, formula}.

Which caster-type strings (a class/subclass's own `caster_type`) mean what — a `divisor` entry accumulates into spellSlotProgression's caster-level total; an `ownProgression` entry accumulates into its own named progression table instead. Each value is {shortName, divisor?, ownProgression?, name?, reset?}.
This System's own named dice (d4, d20, ...) for the dice-roller widget. Each value is {name, sides}.
Named Rolls/Moves (a fixed dice expression with result bands) for the dice-roller widget. Each value is {name, expression}.
Named card decks for the deck-of-cards widget. Each value is {name, cards: [...]}.
This System's own coin/currency denominations, each with a conversion-rate `cost` (and optionally `weight` for the Inventory Weight calculator). Each value is {name, cost}.
This System's own starting-inventory vocabulary. No fixed per-value shape.
Named travel speeds (On Foot, Mounted, ...) for overland-travel calculations. Each value is {name, speedMph}.
Dashboard's character-level XP-threshold/encounter-difficulty table. Each value is {level, xpToLevel, easy, medium, hard, deadly}.
